Players Committee card image of [[Sonic Bombardment (V)]] (original printing), game text: “USED: Take any one Downtown Plaza or prison into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. LOST: Search your Reserve Deck, take any one unique (•) bounty into hand; reshuffle. OR Target an alien. For remainder of turn, target is power and forfeit -1 (-3 if Chewie).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/sonicbombardment.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
